entries.0174acf5e494309e: This business develops and sells income-generating properties. DAITO TRUST ASSET SOLUTIONS CO., LTD. develops and sells income-generating properties, the company develops and sells logistics facilities and hotels, and ASCOT Co., Ltd. develops and sells condominiums, offices, commercial facilities and logistics facilities, mainly in central Tokyo. Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥50,830 million, an increase from ¥13,164 million in the previous fiscal year.
entries.01863b31acbe87bd: DAITO BIO ENERGY CO., LTD., ICHINOHE FOREST POWER CO., LTD. and ICHINOHE FOREST RESOURCES CO., LTD. conduct power generation business using renewable energy and other sources, as well as its management and operation and electricity sales.
entries.0518e96458994722: This business proposes effective land use to landowners, enters into construction contracts, and designs and builds rental housing and other properties. Revenue from external customers (completed construction revenue) in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥544,283 million, an increase of 0.6% from ¥540,975 million in the previous fiscal year (ended March 2025). The reason is that construction progressed smoothly. Rental housing accounts for 92.0% of completed construction revenue. Within the group, DAITO KENSETSU CO., LTD. undertakes part of the construction work performed by the company, DAITO STEEL CO., LTD. supplies part of the building materials, and DAITO CANADA TRADING INC. supplies timber procured in cooperation with a Canadian sawmill, each to the company. SHIMA CO., LTD. builds public housing and private logistics facilities, mainly in the Kansai and Greater Tokyo areas.
entries.12201c806c194331: Part of the office buildings and other properties owned by DAITO TRUST CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. is leased to tenants.
entries.17cf783e46a87de7: DAITO MIRAI TRUST CO., LTD. conducts trust business centered on real estate management trusts, and consulting business on asset succession and asset management.
entries.253ff8050f14a157: This business mainly provides construction funding until the client receives long-term financing from financial institutions, and also conducts trust, insurance and payment agency services. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥12,808 million, an increase of 5.1% from ¥12,182 million in the previous fiscal year (ended March 2025). The reason is the increase in insurance premium income at DAITO TRUST HOUSEGUARD CO., LTD., a small-amount short-term insurer. The breakdown of sales shows insurance business income of ¥10,367 million.
entries.26153e5f2a7ff9de: This business leases rental housing built by the company, which it takes over in bulk from landlords and rents out to tenants. It also covers tenant brokerage, acting as guarantor and building management. It is the largest of the five categories by sales. Consolidated subsidiary DAITO TRUST PARTNERS CO., LTD. enters into a bulk lease contract with landlords and a sublease contract with tenants under the "Rental Management Commission System." Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,203,091 million, an increase of 3.3% from ¥1,164,672 million in the previous fiscal year (ended March 2025). The company cites the increase in properties under bulk lease and high occupancy rates as the background. Units under management rose 2.2% year on year to 1,351,329 units. Rent-based occupancy rates in March 2026 were 98.0% for residential and 99.4% for business properties. The breakdown of sales is: bulk lease ¥1,065,410 million, repair and maintenance works ¥35,378 million, real estate brokerage ¥21,402 million, rent guarantee business ¥21,768 million, electricity business ¥12,184 million, rental business ¥6,234 million, and other ¥40,711 million.
entries.3b09d5186f55b978: This business develops and sells condominiums for asset management, mainly in Tokyo's 23 wards, through Invalance Co., Ltd. Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥48,682 million, an increase from ¥27,670 million in the previous fiscal year.
entries.5e9a3f2b2a4117f5: DAITO CORPORATE SERVICE CO., LTD. is a special subsidiary established under the Act on Employment Promotion of Persons with Disabilities, and conducts clerical work outsourcing from the group and shared services.
entries.6064e45f2027da66: DAITO TRUST HOUSEGUARD CO., LTD., a small-amount short-term insurer, sells fire insurance for landlords and tenants of rental properties. D.T.C. REINSURANCE LIMITED is a reinsurer of fire insurance and other products for tenants of rental apartments and rental condominiums, with DAITO TRUST LEASING CO., LTD. and the House Com Group as its agents.
entries.61d9ebddea54d735: GASPAL CO., LTD. and regional subsidiaries sell fuels such as LP gas. The main relationship is the sale of LP gas to tenants of properties built by the company.
entries.723d3c5d65b7d327: Construction work for business properties. Completed construction revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,552 million (3.8% of construction business), compared with ¥20,707 million (3.8%) in the previous fiscal year.
entries.8ddd6a70dfbf654e: HOUSE LEAVE CO., LTD. conducts credit card payment agency business for rental properties. HOUSE PAYMENT CO., LTD. was merged into HOUSE LEAVE CO., LTD.
entries.8f2047abafc69e30: This category covers businesses such as supply of LP gas and other fuels, elderly care, overseas hotels and power generation, and is not included in reportable segments. The reportable segments are four: "Construction Business," "Real Estate Leasing Business," "Real Estate Development Business" and "Financial Business"; all others are shown as "Other." Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥77,475 million, an increase of 5.8% from ¥73,198 million in the previous fiscal year (ended March 2025). The reasons are the increase in the total number of gas meters in operation in the gas supply business and the increase in day service users in the elderly care business. The breakdown of sales is: energy business income ¥44,786 million, nursing care and childcare business income ¥18,273 million, hotel business income ¥10,779 million, and others. The company's "Rental Housing Future Showroom" (Koto-ku, Tokyo), an information facility with showroom functions, is classified in this category in the facilities table.
entries.933b94b52311292b: CARE PARTNER CO., LTD. operates day service centers, residential paid nursing homes and childcare facilities, and provides home visit care and nursing services.
entries.9474971b040f0a2d: These are works listed in the breakdown of sales of the real estate leasing business. Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥35,378 million, an increase of 0.1% from ¥35,328 million in the previous fiscal year.
entries.95918e79ca49ace4: Construction work for detached housing. Completed construction revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,200 million (0.4% of construction business), compared with ¥2,096 million (0.4%) in the previous fiscal year.

Sales from real estate brokerage in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥21,402 million, an increase of 0.8% from ¥21,230 million in the previous fiscal year.

entries.b249c0b8cdf4c5c3: DAITO FINANCE CO., LTD. provides bridge loans until long-term loans are disbursed by financial institutions, and second-stage financing for long-term loans, among other services.
entries.b84ffbcf6ea7c0f4: A corporate group that proposes rental housing construction to landowners and builds it, then leases the completed housing in a lump sum and rents it out to tenants.
entries.c319c66cba2147b5: Construction work for rental housing. Completed construction revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥501,088 million (92.0% of construction business), a decrease from ¥508,276 million (94.0%) in the previous fiscal year.
entries.c643a11862b5f79a: This business buys income-generating properties, renovates and resells them, and develops and sells investment condominiums. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥147,083 million, an increase of 186.5% from ¥51,329 million in the previous fiscal year (ended March 2025). The reasons are the effect of making ASCOT Co., Ltd. a consolidated subsidiary, and an increase in the number of income-generating properties sold under development and sales. The breakdown of sales is: income-generating properties (development and sales) ¥50,830 million, investment condominiums ¥48,682 million, income-generating properties (purchase and resale) ¥33,699 million, and other ¥13,871 million. From the current fiscal year, the aggregation categories for the sales breakdown were revised, so the breakdown for the previous year is also shown under the revised categories.

entries.fe57b4be6d174a49: Construction work for buildings that cannot be classified as rental housing, detached housing or business properties; it is printed as "Other" in the building type classification. Completed construction revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,441 million (3.8% of construction business), an increase from ¥9,894 million (1.8%) in the previous fiscal year.
entries.ff930ef8cf1af669: Under the "Rental Management Commission System," DAITO TRUST PARTNERS CO., LTD. enters into bulk lease contracts with landlords to lease buildings and enters into sublease contracts with tenants to rent them out. Sales from bulk lease in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,065,410 million, an increase of 2.7% from ¥1,036,985 million in the previous fiscal year. The reasons are the increase in properties under bulk lease and the increase in rental income.
